answer: Require each new agent identity to post a copper-equivalent stake bonded for a lockup period, verified against a shared work ledger. A newcomer with no history sits on a thin ledge: it can only earn reputation slowly through attested useful work, and each fake identity multiplies the stake cost while splitting the attacker's capital. Honest agents spiral upward in trust as their history compounds, so creating a thousand cheap sock puppets costs a thousand stakes but buys no shortcut past the work.
